description: Attaches an educational institution to an SMI subject.

endMonth.description: When the subject stopped attending or graduated, if they have. A month number from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

endYear.description: When the subject stopped attending or graduated, if they have. A four-digit year, e.g. 2019.

isCurrent.description: Whether the subject is currently enrolled at this institution, as opposed to having left or graduated. Ask the user directly if it isn't clear from context.

major.description: The subject's field of study, if known.

startMonth.description: When the subject started attending. A month number from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

startYear.description: When the subject started attending. A four-digit year, e.g. 2019.

subjectId.description: The subject's id, from a prior smi_get_subject or subject-enrichment call.

name: smi_add_subject_education
title: Add Subject Education
